name: Michael Maio
positioningLine: Full-stack engineer. I ship mobile apps and AI products, start to finish.
contextSentence: Ten years building React Native apps, web platforms, and lately AI assistants, for startups, agencies, and nonprofits.
aboutText: Before I wrote software I was a musician and audio engineer: years of tracking, mixing, and shipping records on deadline. It turns out that's good training for engineering — listen closely, cut what doesn't serve the song, and ship.
toolkit: Current toolkit: TypeScript, React, React Native, Node, Python, LangChain, AWS.
closingLine: Need a senior engineer, for a role or a project? Let's talk.
